negative_findings.description: No SI-specific KPMG banking or payments research publication surfaced in either English or Slovenian searching; kpmg.com/si presents financial services as a practice area but no report index with SI banking studies was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: KPMG SI recorded only as a pointer/watch-point with low usefulness; no report URL asserted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-crediting the Big Four uniformly — for SI, Deloitte is clearly the productive one and KPMG/EY are thin.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian fintech industry association publishing a market overview was found; the query for 'Slovensko fintech združenje' returned no such body. The nearest institutional locus is Banka Slovenije's Fintech Innovation Hub, which belongs to the regulator cell, not this one.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SI fintech-association aggregator source exists as far as this search could establish.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A structural gap: SI has no industry-body fintech market report, so market sizing must come from foreign commercial aggregators (GlobalData, Statista) or vendor surveys.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenia-specific Visa consumer payment attitudes study was located; Visa's Consumer Payment Attitudes Study editions found are Asia-Pacific. Slovenian-language search for a Visa raziskava returned nothing relevant.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mastercard's Masterindex is the only vendor-run SI consumer payment survey identified; Visa has no SI counterpart found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means the attitudinal series has a single sponsor, so sponsor bias cannot be triangulated across schemes.

negative_findings.description: Masterindex results have no stable canonical Mastercard Slovenia landing page in the results found; each wave is discoverable only through scattered SI media, SOZ and (historically) the Banka Slovenije National Payments Council e-news.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection must be alert-driven across many domains rather than a single feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A URL-based monitor would miss waves; the collection design must be keyword-based.

negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with reduced confidence pending the deterministic verification pass.

coverage_gaps.description: The only genuinely SI-specific instrument-level market sizing (GlobalData, ResearchAndMarkets yearbook, Argus Advisory) is entirely behind commercial paywalls; only abstracts and press releases are harvestable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for one edition of the GlobalData or Argus Slovenia report to anchor the series, and otherwise systematically harvest free abstracts and vendor press releases each cycle.

coverage_gaps.description: Nothing in this cell produced independent ATM/POS terminal-estimate series or cash-logistics analysis; the aggregators reference POS/ATM counts only inside paywalled products, and no consultancy paper on SI cash infrastructure was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on the regulator/official-statistics cells for ATM/POS counts and use this cell only for forecasts and attitudinal colour; explicitly cross-check any aggregator ATM/POS figure against Banka Slovenije.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian-language consultancy output is thin: apart from Deloitte SI's DBM article and EY SI's insights feed, the Big Four publish about Slovenia mainly in English regional reports. Local-language depth comes instead from academia (RUL, CEK) and survey/media relays.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Weight academic repositories and SI media relays more heavily for sl-language coverage of this cell rather than expecting sl consultancy reports.

coverage_gaps.description: Global research houses likely to hold SI cuts were not individually confirmed this pass: Capgemini World Payments Report, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman, Kearney European Retail Banking Radar, and Euromonitor/Mintel consumer-finance data.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on these five aggregators specifically querying Slovenia country coverage before declaring the cell complete.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian survey houses beyond Valicon (Mediana, Ninamedia, Aragon, Parsifal) were not individually searched, and none was confirmed to run a payments-specific tracker.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Second pass in Slovenian on 'agencija za raziskavo trga' + 'plačila'/'banke' to enumerate the national survey-house landscape.

brief: For Slovenia, the aggregator/consultancy landscape splits into three tiers. Foreign commercial research houses (GlobalData, ResearchAndMarkets, Argus Advisory, Statista) hold the only genuinely SI-specific cards-and-payments sizing and forecast series — instrument-level volumes, issuer/scheme shares, cash share above 40% of volume — but almost all of it sits behind paywalls, leaving only abstracts and press releases freely harvestable. Among the Big Four, only Deloitte produces reliable Slovenia-specific output (Digital Banking Maturity, CE Banking Outlook, CEE M&A Banking Study, plus a Slovenian-language DBM write-up); PwC, EY and KPMG SI offer publication indexes worth monitoring but no confirmed SI banking or payments study. Attitudinal data on cash versus cards comes almost entirely from Mastercard's Masterindex survey, released through scattered SI media rather than a stable page, with no Visa counterpart found — a single-sponsor dependency worth flagging. Slovenian-language depth is supplied instead by academia: the RUL and CEK repositories carry full-text theses reproducing SI card, POS and interchange tables, and SICRIS/COBISS provides a systematic pointer into every SI researcher and project in the field.
